title: A School Sports Day（學校運動會）
passage:
Every autumn, Wenshan Junior High holds a sports day, and this year Mia could not wait to compete. She had practiced running every morning before school, hoping to become the fastest runner in her class.

When the sports day began, the whole school gathered on the field. Teachers announced each event through a loudspeaker, and students cheered loudly for their teammates. "You can do it! Don't give up!" Mia's friends shouted as she lined up for the 100-meter race.

The race was one of the most exciting events of the day. While Mia was running, she suddenly heard her name being called from the crowd. That gave her the courage to run even faster. She crossed the finish line first and won a gold medal.

Later, Mia's class took part in the tug-of-war. It was tough, but everyone pulled together as a team. Unfortunately, they lost to the class next door. "It's okay," said their teacher. "Losing a game doesn't mean you failed. What matters is that you tried your best and encouraged each other."

By the end of the day, Mia was exhausted but proud. She had won a medal, made new memories with her teammates, and learned that teamwork is just as important as victory. As she walked home, she was already looking forward to next year's sports day.

grammar: 最高級 the + 形容詞-est/most + 名詞：表示在某個範圍中「最...的」，用來比較三者(含)以上。例如：Mia hoped to become the fastest runner in her class.；It was one of the toughest games of the day.
one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞：表示「...之一」，強調某事物在同類中名列前茅，後面一定接複數名詞。例如：The race was one of the most exciting events of the day.；Tug-of-war is one of the most popular games at school sports days.

when/while + 過去進行式，主要子句用過去簡單式：表示「正當...的時候，另一件事發生了」，過去進行式描述背景中正在進行的動作。例如：While Mia was running, she suddenly heard her name being called from the crowd.；While the students were practicing hard, the crowd cheered loudly for them.

reading.q: Why did Mia practice running every morning before school?
opts: To become the fastest runner in her class
Because her teacher told her to
reading.ex: 文中提到 hoping to become the fastest runner in her class，她練跑是希望成為班上跑最快的人。

reading.q: How did the teachers announce each event on sports day?
reading.ex: 文中提到 Teachers announced each event through a loudspeaker，老師是用擴音器宣布項目。

reading.q: What happened while Mia was running the race?
opts: She heard her name being called from the crowd
reading.ex: 文中提到 While Mia was running, she suddenly heard her name being called from the crowd。

reading.q: What was the result of the tug-of-war for Mia's class?
opts: They lost to the class next door
reading.ex: 文中提到 Unfortunately, they lost to the class next door，Mia 的班級輸給了隔壁班。

reading.q: What did Mia learn by the end of sports day?
opts: Winning is the only thing that matters
Teamwork is just as important as victory
Running is more important than resting
She should quit sports day next year
reading.ex: 文中提到 she learned that teamwork is just as important as victory。

grammar.q: Mia hoped to become ___ runner in her class.
grammar.ex: 表示「班上最快的」要用最高級 the fastest，故選 C。

grammar.q: The 100-meter race was one of ___ events of the sports day.
grammar.ex: one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞，表示「最...的其中之一」，故選 the most exciting。

grammar.q: ___ Mia was running, she suddenly heard her name from the crowd.
grammar.ex: 表示「正當...的時候」要用 While 加過去進行式，故選 While。

grammar.q: While the students ___ hard, the crowd cheered loudly for them.
grammar.ex: while 子句表示背景中正在進行的動作，要用過去進行式 were practicing。

grammar.q: Tug-of-war is one of ___ games at school sports days.
grammar.ex: one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞的固定用法，須加 the，故選 the most popular。

vocab.q: "compete" 這個字的中文意思最接近？
vocab.ex: compete 指「比賽、競爭」，文中指 Mia 想參加運動會的比賽。

vocab.q: 選出與 "courage" 意思最接近的選項：
vocab.ex: courage 指「勇氣」，意思最接近 bravery。

vocab.q: "Mia was ___ but proud by the end of the day." 依句意選出最適合的字：
vocab.ex: 句意指 Mia 到了一天結束時感到「精疲力盡」，應選 exhausted。

vocab.q: 下列何者最能形容 "tough" 這個字？
vocab.ex: tough 指「艱難的、強悍的」，文中形容拔河比賽很艱難。
